newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Bank to offer fund-pooling services in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Bank to offer fund-pooling services in Europe.

text.p: Fuji Bank Ltd said on Tuesday it plans to offer a new service in Europe enabling Japanese firms to cut settlement-related costs by pooling funds held by their European units.

The service, to be launched before the end of the current fiscal year to March 1998, will facilitate the monitoring of finances at a company's European operations and reduce interest payments by netting the European units' transactions, a Fuji Bank spokesman said.
Demand for such centralised cash management services is expected to pick up in Europe ahead of the launch of a single European currency in 1999, the spokesman said.
With the new service, Fuji hopes to compete with European and U.S. banks that are winning business from Japanese firms in Europe, the spokesman said.
